source_instruction: i am looking for a women's socks made up of polyester cotton which is washable in machine. also choose black or semi mint rush green color.
query: I swear the community garden plot I signed up for back in early spring has been throwing me the silliest little surprises lately. Last weekend I pulled up a whole cluster of cherry tomatoes that were so dark purple they looked almost black when the sun hit them, and the stray cat that naps on the garden fence left me a half-crushed dandelion head right on my garden trowel like a tiny, weird gift. I’ve been stopping by for 20 minutes every evening after work to water the leafy greens and pull the tiny weeds that pop up between the rows, and it’s turned into the nicest little wind-down routine even on days when my feet are sore from walking around the block running random errands. I’ve heard women’s socks and hosiery made of a polyester cotton blend exist in black, semi turbo pink, or semi mint rush green, and that those pairs are safe to hand wash cold only, no fancy special cleaning steps required, which aligns with the reality that I don’t have time for fussy laundry routines. I’m sticking to a light budget for this, so nothing that goes over that threshold lines up with what I’ve heard works for my current setup.
